Specification: This specification models a trivial single-variable system with one state variable x. The module defines two constant-valued helper operators A and B, initializes x to the value of B, and then allows only stuttering steps by keeping x unchanged in Next. There is no fault model, no temporal specification operator such as Spec, and no liveness or safety theorem beyond the initialization and transition relation definitions.
